PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
AI Engineer — JudgeService Research Ltd     Jan 2024 to Present
AI-Powered Review Response System — Live Across Major UK Dealer Groups
•    Built an LLM service that drafts three reply options for every customer review (detailed, professional, short), with sentiment-conditioned prompts and per-dealership rules baked in; the dealer picks one and publishes. Roughly 93% of drafts go out without an edit, across over 100k reviews a month.
•    Fine-tuned Llama 3 8B with LoRA/QLoRA (Unsloth) on examples generated by a 70B model, distilling its ability to follow strict client wording rules that the base model couldn't manage, while keeping small-model speed and cost.
•    Deployed on AWS EC2, configuring NVIDIA drivers and the Linux environment from scratch, then led the migration to an on-prem GPU server and added database-level caching of repeat requests to cut costs and response times.
Customer Insight AI Agent & Sentiment Platform
•    Designed a multi-agent NLP pipeline that turns raw reviews into structured JSON: review-type classification, per-topic sentiment, supporting evidence quotes and staff-name linking, feeding the dashboards clients use for reporting (contributed to a 20% lift in client retention).
•    Cut inference costs with a two-tier routing architecture: urgent single reviews go to the Gemini API for low-latency responses, while large batch jobs run on a self-hosted Gemma 27B on the company's own GPU hardware, keeping per-review inference costs down.
•    Raised subcategory recall from 0.78 to 0.96 (F1 0.98), measured on a 500-review golden set of hard cases, then locked the gains in with a regression suite that re-runs the set on every change and fails the build if accuracy drops.
•    Adopted by account managers to prepare for client meetings: per-dealer breakdowns show exactly where a dealership is struggling before the team walks in, sharpening renewal and upsell conversations.
RAG Documentation Engine, QA Automation & Mentoring
•    Built a privacy-first RAG pipeline that documents legacy PHP/JS codebases with no code leaving company infrastructure: LangChain ingestion, 2,000-character chunking, Linq-Embed-Mistral embeddings in a local Chroma store, and Llama 3 via Ollama; retrieval surrounds each chunk with related cross-file context, cutting manual documentation work by 90%.
•    Developed an automated call-quality assessment tool using WhisperX transcription (STT) and rule-based LLM analysis, replacing manual QA audits.
•    Ran internal workshops on LLM capabilities and prompt engineering, accelerating adoption of AI tooling across the development team.
